defmodule ChatServer.FeatureFlags do
  use GenServer

  @moduledoc """
  Feature flag system with real-time propagation to connected clients.
  Flags are evaluated lazily and cached per-session.
  """

  defstruct [:flags, :pending_updates, :version]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(_opts) do
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{flags: %{}, pending_updates: :queue.new(), version: 0}}
  end

  def get_flag(flag_name, user_context) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:get_flag, flag_name, user_context})
  end

  def update_flag(flag_name, value, admin_context) do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:update_flag, flag_name, value, admin_context})
  end

  def handle_call({:get_flag, flag_name, user_context}, _from, state) do
    {result, new_state} = evaluate_flag(flag_name, user_context, state)
    {:reply, result, new_state}
  end

  def handle_cast({:update_flag, flag_name, value, admin_context}, state) do
    if authorized_admin?(admin_context) do
      new_pending = :queue.in({flag_name, value, state.version}, state.pending_updates)
      {:noreply, %{state | pending_updates: new_pending}}
    else
      {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_info(:commit_pending, state) do
    {new_flags, new_queue} = apply_pending(state.flags, state.pending_updates)
    {:noreply, %{state | flags: new_flags, pending_updates: new_queue, version: state.version + 1}}
  end

  defp evaluate_flag(flag_name, _user_context, state) do
    case Map.get(state.flags, flag_name) do
      nil -> {false, state}
      value -> {value, state}
    end
  end

  defp apply_pending(flags, queue) do
    case :queue.out(queue) do
      {{:value, {name, value, _ver}}, rest} ->
        apply_pending(Map.put(flags, name, value), rest)
      {:empty, queue} ->
        {flags, queue}
    end
  end

  defp authorized_admin?(%{role: :admin}), do: true
  defp authorized_admin?(_), do: false
end

defmodule ChatServer.Room do
  use GenServer

  @moduledoc """
  Chat room with feature-flag-gated message processing.
  Supports rate limiting and message filtering based on flags.
  """

  defstruct [:room_id, :members, :message_queue, :processing_lock]

  def start_link(room_id) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, room_id, name: via(room_id))
  end

  def init(room_id) do
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{
      room_id: room_id,
      members: MapSet.new(),
      message_queue: :queue.new(),
      processing_lock: false
    }}
  end

  def send_message(room_id, user, content) do
    GenServer.call(via(room_id), {:send_message, user, content})
  end

  def handle_call({:send_message, user, content}, _from, state) do
    rate_limit_enabled = ChatServer.FeatureFlags.get_flag(:rate_limiting, %{user: user})
    
    if rate_limit_enabled do
      case check_rate_limit(user, state) do
        :ok -> process_message(user, content, state)
        :rate_limited -> {:reply, {:error, :rate_limited}, state}
      end
    else
      process_message(user, content, state)
    end
  end

  defp process_message(user, content, state) do
    moderation_enabled = ChatServer.FeatureFlags.get_flag(:content_moderation, %{user: user})
    
    sanitized = if moderation_enabled do
      moderate_content(content)
    else
      content
    end

    msg = %{user: user, content: sanitized, timestamp: System.monotonic_time()}
    new_queue = :queue.in(msg, state.message_queue)
    
    # Capture flag state at send time for consistent delivery
    encryption_at_send = ChatServer.FeatureFlags.get_flag(:e2e_encryption, %{room: state.room_id})
    schedule_broadcast(state.room_id, msg, encryption_at_send)
    
    {:reply, :ok, %{state | message_queue: new_queue}}
  end

  defp schedule_broadcast(room_id, msg, encryption_enabled) do
    # Delivery uses flag state captured at send time - no TOCTOU
    Task.start(fn ->
      Process.sleep(1)
      deliver_to_members(room_id, msg, encryption_enabled)
    end)
  end

  defp deliver_to_members(room_id, msg, encryption_enabled) do
    payload = if encryption_enabled do
      encrypt_payload(msg)
    else
      msg
    end
    
    Phoenix.PubSub.broadcast(ChatServer.PubSub, "room:#{room_id}", {:new_message, payload})
  end

  defp check_rate_limit(user, state) do
    recent = state.message_queue
    |> :queue.to_list()
    |> Enum.filter(fn m -> m.user == user end)
    |> Enum.filter(fn m -> System.monotonic_time() - m.timestamp < 5_000_000_000 end)
    
    if length(recent) >= 10, do: :rate_limited, else: :ok
  end

  defp moderate_content(content) do
    content
    |> String.replace(~r/<script[^>]*>.*?<\/script>/is, "[removed]")
    |> String.replace(~r/[\x00-\x08\x0B\x0C\x0E-\x1F]/, "")
  end

  # Use real authenticated encryption (AES-256-GCM) instead of Base64 encoding.
  # The 256-bit key must be provisioned securely (env/secret store), never hard-coded.
  defp encrypt_payload(msg) do
    key = encryption_key()
    iv = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(12)
    aad = "chat-message"

    {ciphertext, tag} =
      :crypto.crypto_one_time_aead(:aes_256_gcm, key, iv, msg.content, aad, true)

    encoded =
      Enum.map_join([iv, tag, ciphertext], ":", &Base.encode64/1)

    %{msg | content: encoded}
  end

  defp encryption_key do
    case System.get_env("CHAT_E2E_KEY") do
      nil ->
        raise "CHAT_E2E_KEY is not configured; cannot perform encryption"

      encoded ->
        key = Base.decode64!(encoded)

        unless byte_size(key) == 32 do
          raise "CHAT_E2E_KEY must be a base64-encoded 32-byte key"
        end

        key
    end
  end

  defp via(room_id), do: {:via, Registry, {ChatServer.Registry, room_id}}
end

defmodule ChatServer.FlagAdmin do
  @moduledoc """
  Admin interface for toggling feature flags.
  Changes are staged and committed on next tick.
  """

  def toggle_moderation(admin_ctx, enabled) do
    ChatServer.FeatureFlags.update_flag(:content_moderation, enabled, admin_ctx)
  end

  def toggle_rate_limiting(admin_ctx, enabled) do
    ChatServer.FeatureFlags.update_flag(:rate_limiting, enabled, admin_ctx)
  end

  def toggle_encryption(admin_ctx, enabled) do
    ChatServer.FeatureFlags.update_flag(:e2e_encryption, enabled, admin_ctx)
  end

  def commit_changes do
    send(ChatServer.FeatureFlags, :commit_pending)
  end
end
